opportunities.point: The company is targeting an EBITDA of approximately INR 2,400 crore by the end of FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026 for modules and March 2027 for cells.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt expansion is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Debt is being paid down - interest cost should keep falling.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 6.52% earnings growth vs 158% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
A capital goods tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management expects DCR demand to strengthen throughout FY2027 as projects align with ALMM requirements.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We expect DCR demand to strengthen progressively during FY2027 as grandfathered non-DCR projects are completed and procurement aligned with ALMM requirements becomes more broad-based." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company's order book stood at 9.9 gigawatts at the end of Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Current installed capacity is 10.3 gigawatts of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatts of TOPCon cells.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Commission the module line of the 6-gigawatt facility by December 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026" (concall transcript - 2026-07-01) [H2 FY26]

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 1,082 -> 1,274 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 614 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 200 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Receivables are stretching year on year.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.05 pp, DII -2.7 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that geopolitical issues have led to a strategic increase in raw material inventory.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "And added to that, this quarter we have strategically kept little more raw material inventory. Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Management identified risks including fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition, and changes in regulatory environments.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These forward-looking statements are based on certain expectations, assumptions, anticipated developments and other factors which are not limited to, risk and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition and the pricing..." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun) are still in the cycle.
